title: How I Got Into Programming
story: My interest in programming came from curiosity about how software actually works. What started as experimentation gradually became a passion for building applications and solving problems through technology.

title: Why I Chose Computer Science
story: Computer Science combines creativity, logic and problem solving. I enjoy the process of turning ideas into working products and constantly learning new technologies.

title: Why Flutter Became My Favorite Technology
story: Flutter's UI flexibility, performance and developer experience made it my preferred framework for mobile development.

title: Why I Built DropNet
story: I wanted offline file sharing to be simple, fast and reliable. Existing solutions often felt unnecessarily complicated or dependent on internet connectivity.

title: My Biggest Achievement
story: My biggest achievement isn't a certificate or a grade. It's building applications that people can actually use.

title: Hardest Debugging Experience
story: Networking and device-to-device communication bugs have been some of the most difficult issues I've encountered because they can be inconsistent and difficult to reproduce.

title: How I Learn
story: I learn best by building. Creating projects, experimenting, breaking things and fixing them teaches me more than passive learning.

title: Future Goals
story: I want to become a highly skilled software engineer who builds impactful products and continuously learns emerging technologies.

title: How I Use AI
story: I use AI as a productivity and learning accelerator for research, debugging, architecture discussions and exploring new ideas.

title: What Recruiters Should Know
story: I enjoy building real software, learning independently and improving products through iteration. I value practical experience and continuous growth.
